title: Braze - Customer engagement platform with AI product recommendations
clean_text: Braze is a customer engagement platform delivering personalized cross-channel messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app, with product recommendations embedded through Connected Content and standardized eCommerce Recommended Events. Turns real-time shopping behaviors such as abandoned cart, abandoned browse, and order confirmation into automated personalization triggers. Recommendations are primarily message-embedded rather than onsite storefront widgets, distinguishing it from dedicated recommendation platforms. Publicly traded company serving digital-first companies including ecommerce businesses and mobile app developers. Targets mid-market to enterprise companies focused on engagement and retention rather than onsite merchandising alone.
